trello.name: Update product roadmap for dark mode dependency
trello.desc: Update the roadmap document to remove dark mode as a standalone Q3 committed item and reflect the decision made in the product sync. Move dark mode under the September design-system upgrade line item to indicate it is delivered as part of that upgrade. Acceptance criteria: roadmap doc shows dark mode no longer listed under 'Q3 committed' as standalone, it is listed as included with the September design-system upgrade which ships with theming built in, and the change is saved and visible to sales/product stakeholders so dark mode is not promised as a separate deliverable this cycle.

trello.name: Fix typo in onboarding email subject line
trello.desc: Correct the spelling error in the onboarding email template identified by Marketing. The subject line currently contains 'recieve' and must be changed to 'receive'. Steps: open the email template repo, edit the onboarding email subject line to fix the typo, commit and push the fix today, and submit for re-approval through the normal email template approval process. Acceptance criteria: subject line renders as 'receive' with no typo, change is merged in the email template repo, and re-approval is obtained before the email is sent.

trello.name: Benchmark PgBouncer transaction mode for dashboard connection contention
trello.desc: Investigate dashboard slowness for accounts with many projects which profiling shows is 80% database wait due to connection contention, not query cost. Evaluate connection pooling as the remediation instead of database migration. Steps: set up a load test that mirrors the dashboard's query pattern, benchmark p95 latency with the current connection setup versus PgBouncer running in transaction mode, and document results. Acceptance criteria: load test reproduces dashboard workload, p95 latency measurements are captured for both current setup and PgBouncer transaction mode, results and recommendation are prepared to present at the next product sync. Note: team has decided to remain on Postgres with no MongoDB migration or evaluation.
